Package com.ebu6304.group48.model

Class Invitation

java.lang.Object
com.ebu6304.group48.model.Invitation
public class Invitation extends Object
Represents an MO invitation sent to a TA for a specific job. TAs can accept (auto-creates an Application) or decline.

Status flow: PENDING → ACCEPTED | DECLINED | EXPIRED

JSON example:

 {
   "invitationId": "I-ABC12345",
   "jobId": "J001",
   "moUserId": "U-DEMO-MO",
   "taUserId": "U-DEMO-TA",
   "status": "PENDING",
   "createdAt": "2026-05-23T12:00:00Z",
   "updatedAt": "2026-05-23T12:00:00Z"
 }
